# External BPMN fixture notices

Files in this directory are immutable test fixtures. Their adjacent
`.provenance.json` manifests pin the exact source commit, raw URL, checksum,
producer evidence, namespace inventory, license and bounded claim.

## BPMN Model Interchange Working Group

`miwg-reference-call-activity-local.bpmn` and
`miwg-signavio-message-catch.bpmn` originate from the
[BPMN MIWG Test Suite](https://github.com/bpmn-miwg/bpmn-miwg-test-suite) at
commit `cb2629519cee6280ab521f99dc46a9815a221a35`.

The BPMN MIWG states that submitted test results are published under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
The first file is the MIWG `Reference/C.5.0.bpmn` model; the second is the
`SAP Signavio Process Manager 19.9.0/C.1.0-export.bpmn` submission. Both files
are preserved byte-for-byte and are used only for bounded interoperability
contract testing.

## bpmn-js fixtures

Fixtures sourced from bpmn-js are pinned to its custom bpmn.io license, identified
locally as `LicenseRef-bpmn-io`, not plain MIT. The linked upstream license includes
an additional requirement to keep the bpmn.io watermark fully visible and unmodified
in rendered diagrams. The Camunda Modeler collaboration fixture retains its separately
pinned MIT source license. Exact source paths and license links are recorded in the
adjacent manifests. No fixture is generated by TEB and
no manifest claims full BPMN conformance, runtime execution or universal
interoperability.

Full pinned license texts are included in [licenses/bpmn-js.txt](licenses/bpmn-js.txt), [licenses/camunda-modeler.txt](licenses/camunda-modeler.txt) and [licenses/bpmn-moddle.txt](licenses/bpmn-moddle.txt).
